profile.summary: Building Opportunities for Self-Sufficiency (BOSS) is a nonprofit based in Berkeley, California. It works to address poverty, homelessness, incarceration and violence through housing programs, wellness and empowerment services, trauma recovery, career support and other community services in Alameda County.
